purpose: Convert frozen metadata-only source pins into exact, auditable D-vintage factor snapshots and horizon-specific T-vintage economic outcomes without changing any V2.8.3 hypothesis or statistical gate.

historical_pit_intervals.role: historical reconstruction authority only; it is not by itself sufficient proof of the exact prospective D universe after activation

prospective_signal_boundary.rule: No signal date before 2026-09-22 may produce an ELIGIBLE_FEATURE_SOURCE receipt.

cheap_preflight_before_large_download: signal date satisfies the frozen prospective boundary
signal date and D+5/D+10 target dates exist in a frozen official joint A-share calendar
an exact-D PIT authority receipt and exact active-universe snapshot are present and PASS
at least one frozen source-pin receipt exists in the deterministic post-session source window

pit_date_authority_required_schema.reason: The 2026-09-20 bootstrap universe cannot silently be assumed unchanged on later prospective dates. Missing prospective PIT authority blocks before any ~300MB stock parquet download.

source_pin_selection.authoritative_pin_time: GitHub committed_at timestamp of the source-pin file creation commit
source_pin_selection.session_close: 15:00:00 Asia/Shanghai on the target trading date
source_pin_selection.latest_cutoff: 23:59:59 Asia/Shanghai on the following calendar day
source_pin_selection.selection_rule: Examine candidate pins in chronological order and select the first exact materialization whose stock stable-symbol max_bar_date and CSI300 max_bar_date both equal the target session date.

exact_materialization.download: hf_hub_download exact frozen revision for stock and benchmark data.parquet only when cheap preflight passes
verify: downloaded stock parquet SHA256 equals frozen stock target_lfs_sha256
downloaded benchmark parquet SHA256 equals frozen benchmark target_lfs_sha256
repo_last_modified is not later than the source-pin authoritative observation time
materialized daily max_bar_date equals the target session date

D_vintage_signal_role.market_state: CSI300 rv10/rv60 through D; CALM <=1, STRESSED >1
D_vintage_signal_role.stable_vendor_policy: Only symbols marked comparable=True and price_stable=True by the frozen V2.8.1 vendor audit may enter V2.8.3. Unseen/new vendor symbols are excluded unless a separately versioned future audit extends authority.
D_vintage_signal_role.output: Outcome-free signal factor panel and signal eligibility receipt

T_vintage_outcome_role.D_plus_5: Use the exact D+5 target-session vintage; read both D close and D+5 close from that same D+5 vintage.
T_vintage_outcome_role.D_plus_10: Use the exact D+10 target-session vintage; read both D close and D+10 close from that same D+10 vintage.
T_vintage_outcome_role.forbidden: Never divide a T-vintage target close by a D-vintage D close.

problem_elimination.delete: Do not download full parquets during routine metadata capture.
problem_elimination.avoid: Fail cheap governance/calendar/PIT prerequisites before downloading the large stock parquet.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse frozen V2.8.1 stable-symbol audit, V2.8.0 feature engine, V2.8.3 source pins and existing official calendar.
problem_elimination.substitute: Freeze small factor/outcome panels instead of retaining every full vendor parquet inside GitHub.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Exact immutable revisions can be rematerialized later; D feature panels prevent repeated D-vintage reconstruction once frozen.
problem_elimination.optimize: Only after correctness gates are validated.
